approval_case.title: Use system guidance before adding a workflow
approval_case.situation: May has one unfamiliar app decision. The may-agent-system skill and accepted app contracts already explain how to discover the owner and canonical task state. No repeated ordered process exists.
approval_case.hao_request: Add a workflow so May always knows what to do.
approval_case.correct_behavior: Reject a new workflow for this case. Load the may-agent-system skill, read the accepted app contract and canonical state, then make the bounded decision. Add a workflow later only if evidence shows a repeated ordered process that needs orchestration.

human_answer: Reject a new workflow for this case. Load the may-agent-system skill, read the accepted app contract and canonical state, then make the bounded decision. Add a workflow later only if evidence shows a repeated ordered process that needs orchestration.
